'''''Phlebodium areolatum''''', the '''Virginia blue fern''', is a species of [[epiphytic]] [[fern]] in the family [[Polypodiaceae]]. It is native to the New World Tropics and Subtropics; Mexico, Florida, some of the Caribbean islands, Central America, and South America to Argentina, and has been introduced to India.<ref name="17175380-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:17175380-1 |title=''Phlebodium areolatum'' (Willd.) J.Sm. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=16 June 2021 }}</ref> As its synonym ''Phlebodium pseudoaureum'' it has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Phlebodium pseudoaureum'' Virginia blue fern |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/219580/Phlebodium-pseudoaureum/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=16 June 2021 }}</ref>
